proposals.requirement: FR-008 / User Story 2 IDispatcher method inventory; copy_gpu_to_memory_async signature
proposals.current_spec: copy_gpu_to_memory_async(&self, key, ipc_handle: IpcHandle, stream); no batch_populate / tier_event_stats; US2 lists 16 methods
proposals.current_code: copy_gpu_to_memory_async(&self, key, regions: &[IpcHandle], stream); batch_populate and tier_event_stats exist; 22 methods

edits.old: - **Method**: `copy_gpu_to_memory_async(&self, key: CacheKey, ipc_handle: IpcHandle, stream: GpuStream) -> Result<(), DispatcherError>` - DMA copy into reserved slot.
edits.new: - **Method**: `copy_gpu_to_memory_async(&self, key: CacheKey, regions: &[IpcHandle], stream: GpuStream) -> Result<(), DispatcherError>` - DMA copy into reserved slot. The N regions are gathered contiguously into the one slot (region L lands at `slot + sum of preceding region sizes`), so a block split into N per-layer GPU allocations (vLLM 0.23+) is stored as one unit; `regions.len() == 1` is the legacy single-allocation path.

- **Method**: `batch_populate(&self, entries: &[(CacheKey, IpcHandle)]) -> Vec<Result<(), DispatcherError>>` - Semantically `populate` per entry, but all D2H copies are submitted asynchronously and a single `stream_synchronize` covers the batch. Returns one `Result` per entry, in order.

- **Method**: `tier_event_stats(&self) -> TierEventStats` - Cumulative KV-cache tier-movement counters (see FR-018, FR-018a); always populated (not telemetry-gated); implementations that do no tiering return zeroes.
- **Method**: `schedule_write_through(&self, key: CacheKey, size: u32) -> Result<(), DispatcherError>` - Non-blocking, best-effort background write-through; contract in FR-031a.

proposals.current_spec: clear_memory_tier - Evict all memory-tier entries. | flush_to_ssd - Flush pending writes to SSD.
proposals.current_code: clear_memory_tier keeps pinned entries' slots, retries, Timeout after 5 s, counts only cleared; flush_to_ssd returns IoError on a failed write-through, else the count of entries with an SSD offset (repairs cccfb328e, 9bd231d85)

edits.old: - **Method**: `clear_memory_tier(&self) -> Result<usize, DispatcherError>` - Evict all memory-tier entries.
edits.new: - **Method**: `clear_memory_tier(&self) -> Result<usize, DispatcherError>` - Empty the memory tier: entries with an SSD copy are demoted to BlockDevice, entries without one are removed. A **pinned** entry (a lookup, a client `pin`, or the pending write-through's own reference) keeps its slot and is retried; if pinned entries remain when the implementation's bounded wait expires, returns `Timeout` and leaves them resident. `Ok(n)` means the tier was emptied, and `n` counts only entries actually demoted or removed. *(Sync 2026-10-21 — CODE CHANGE, repair `cccfb328e`; behaviour in dispatcher spec 001 FR-038.)*

edits.old: - **Method**: `flush_to_ssd(&self) -> Result<usize, DispatcherError>` - Flush pending writes to SSD.
edits.new: - **Method**: `flush_to_ssd(&self) -> Result<usize, DispatcherError>` - Block until every queued write-through has run. Returns `IoError` if a write-through failed for an entry that is still in the memory tier (that entry has no SSD copy, so a later `clear_memory_tier` would drop its only copy); otherwise returns the number of memory-tier entries that now have a valid SSD offset. *(Sync 2026-10-21 — CODE CHANGE, repair `9bd231d85` / DIS-FLUSH-REPORTS-FAILED-WRITE; behaviour in dispatcher spec 001 FR-056.)*

proposals.current_spec: A pinned entry MUST keep its slot and is retried ... Timeout ... n counts only the entries actually demoted or removed (dispatcher FR-038)
proposals.current_code: Interface doc: 'Entries still being written are removed entirely. Returns the number of entries cleared.' No # Errors.
proposals.proposed: Replace doc lines 806-810 with: demote where possible, remove entries with no SSD copy, keep and retry pinned entries (incl. pending write-through); Ok means the tier was emptied, count = entries actually demoted or removed; # Errors: Timeout if pinned entries remain when the bounded wait expires.
